description: Registry of the Figma sources of design truth. The Design role syncs published variables/components from these into design/tokens/ via the Figma MCP. Entries may share a fileKey: the parent/child split is logical (pages/sections + token namespaces), not necessarily separate files.

focx-foundation.name: Focx — DS-001 Shell - Today
focx-foundation.scopeHint: Single page 'Cover' (0:1) today; roadmap per the cover: foundations → components → patterns → responsive screens. All content is focx.* scope until Connect pages exist.
focx-foundation.contains: focx design system foundation: variables (color, type, spacing, radius) and components

connect.name: Focx — DS-001 Shell - Today
connect.scopeHint: No Connect-specific pages yet — connect.* deltas begin when Connect surfaces are added to this file (or a dedicated file, at which point only this fileKey changes).
connect.contains: Connect's extension layer: connect-specific variables and components

sync.syncedBy: claude-code (bootstrap partial sync — variables consumed by Cover frame 9:7; full extraction when foundation frames land)
